guidance.heading: Guidance
section: •Prorated production reflecting nine months of contributions is expected to be 50,000 - 60,000 ounces of gold, 40 - 50 million pounds of copper, and 100,000 - 180,000 ounces of silver

•Prorated adjusted CAS1 reflecting nine months of results are expected to be $1,300 - $1,600 per gold ounce and $2.00 - $2.30 per pound of copper, which includes non-cash expense of $175 per ounce of gold and $0.24 per pound of copper relating to purchase price allocation ascribed to short-term inventory
•Prorated capital expenditures reflecting nine months of ownership are expected to be $51 - $61 million, reflecting investments related to the ramp-up of C-Zone
•Prorated exploration investment reflecting nine months of activity is expected to be $19 - $23 million ($17 - $19 million expensed and $2 - $4 million capitalized)
